description: Add an audio file to a session — from a public URL (a doseedo-generated song, a separated stem, any https audio) OR from a LOCAL file you uploaded (doseedo_get_upload_url → PUT the bytes → pass the returned audio_key here). Ingested server-side and returned as a sha256 you then use: place it on a track with attach_audio, or load it into a Quick Sampler with load_quick_sampler_sample {track_id, sample_path: "<the sha>"} (bakes into the exported .logicx, no desktop needed — the drum-pack/sample-swap path). Give audio_url OR audio_key.

audio_key.description: audio_key from doseedo_get_upload_url after you PUT a local file to its upload_url (a file from the user's disk, e.g. a drum-pack WAV).

audio_url.description: https URL of the audio — any public URL, or a doseedo result URL from a job (pre-signed links work as-is; no key needed).

name: doseedo_add_audio_to_session
